name: Linux Mint
postStartCommand: bash -c 'command -v tailscale >/dev/null || curl -fsSL https://tailscale.com/install.sh | sh; mkdir -p /workspaces/.tailscale; nohup tailscaled --tun=userspace-networking --state=/workspaces/.tailscale/tailscaled.state --socket=/tmp/tailscaled.sock >/tmp/tailscaled.log 2>&1 &'
